lines.zh: 冰屑从脚踝落下，一步一响。
lines.en: Ice shards drop from my ankles with every step.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草叶结了霜。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass gathers frost.

lines.zh: 冰雕的小脸转过来看你。
lines.en: My small ice-carved face turns to you.

lines.zh: 我眼里没有情绪，只有寒气。
lines.en: My eyes hold no feeling, only cold.

lines.zh: 睫毛上的冰晶，对准了你。
lines.en: The ice on my lashes points at you.
I stare at the blade in your hand.

lines.zh: 我的小臂断成两截，掉在地上。
lines.en: My forearm snaps in two and drops to the ground.

lines.zh: 冰身开始化，我得退回阴影。
lines.en: My ice body melts; I must retreat into shadow.

lines.zh: 我碎了一块，还能再冻上。
lines.en: A piece of me broke off; it will freeze back.

lines.zh: 近来寒意渐增，你感受到了吗？
lines.en: The cold has been growing recently.
The master's scent is near, near.

lines.zh: 追随我，感受冰霜的魔力。
lines.en: Follow me, feel the power of ice.

lines.zh: 寒冰之心，冻结你的灵魂。
lines.en: Heart of ice, freeze your soul.

lines.zh: 寒冷之地，我的栖息之所。

lines.en: Domesticate me, share the ice kiss.

lines.zh: 躲避阳光，保护我的主人。
lines.en: Avoid the sun, protect my master.

lines.zh: 你肩膀碰到我，霜就爬上去了。
lines.en: Your shoulder touches me, and frost climbs it.

lines.zh: 寒冰之下，隐藏着致命的锋芒。
冰做的身体，撞一下就裂。
lines.en: An ice body cracks at one bump.

lines.zh: 寒冰之下，等待着你的命运。
lines.en: Under the ice, your fate awaits.

lines.zh: 寒冷侵袭，你将无所遁形。
冰封你的世界，无法逃脱。
我的冰霜伴侣，我的一半。
lines.en: My ice mate, my other half.

lines.zh: 与我并肩，共同抵御黑暗。
lines.en: Stand with me, against the darkness.
Warmth in the cold, for each other.

lines.zh: 我们的力量，冰与火的结合。
寒冷中的伴侣，彼此依靠。
lines.en: Companion in the cold, each other's support.

lines.zh: 寒冰中，寻找我们的归宿。
冰霜之恋，冰人偶的誓约。
这块冰归我，正好补窟窿。
lines.en: This ice is mine — it fits the hole exactly.

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的队服挡不住我。
lines.en: A slayer uniform won't stop me.

lines.zh: 我捡起地上的碎冰，补到身上。
lines.en: I pick up broken ice and patch it onto myself.

lines.zh: 你的热气，让我的霜更兴奋。
lines.en: Your body heat excites the frost on me.

lines.zh: 我这张小冰脸是童磨捏的。
lines.en: Doma shaped this little ice face.
Frost coats the fingers of this ice doll.

lines.zh: 你踩碎薄冰，我已经听见了。
lines.en: I heard you crack the thin ice.
I recognize the uniform you wear.

lines.zh: 主人一声令下，我转向你。
lines.en: My master gives the word, and I turn to you.
The click of a scabbard lifts my head.

lines.zh: 我举起结冰的手，选了你。
lines.en: I raise a frozen hand and choose you.
The ice mirrors you, and I remember.

lines.zh: 我的冰眼只映出你一个人。
lines.en: My icy eyes reflect only you.

lines.zh: 我是冰做的，也是他做的。
lines.en: I'm made of ice, and made by him.

lines.zh: 小冰偶也能冻住你的脚。
lines.en: Even a small ice doll can freeze your feet.

lines.zh: 我张开五指，霜在指间聚起。
lines.en: I spread my fingers and frost gathers between them.
Ice creeps from my feet toward you.
I make no sound; I only close in.
The ice fog parts, and I am already near.

lines.zh: 我掌心向上，霜沿空气生长。
lines.en: I turn my palm up and frost grows along the air.

lines.zh: 你呼出的白气被我冻住。
lines.en: The white breath you exhale freezes in place.

lines.zh: 我立在雪里，像另一座雪雕。
lines.en: I stand in the snow like another statue.

lines.zh: 寒气顺着你的裤脚往上爬。
lines.en: Chill climbs up your trouser legs.
I slowly raise an ice blade.

lines.zh: 我把你围在一个冰圈里。
lines.en: I pen you inside a ring of ice.
My ice fist slams down in a spray of shards.
The ice blade passes, and skin goes numb.
I cling to you, cold to the bone.
An ice spike jabs out of my palm.
I ram into you like a stone.

lines.zh: 一下，只有一下，力气很小。
lines.en: One hit, just one, and barely strong.

lines.zh: 冰碎在我手里，又长回来。
lines.en: The ice breaks in my grip and grows back.

lines.zh: 童磨抬手，冰里站起一个人偶。
lines.en: Doma raises a hand and a doll rises from the ice.

lines.zh: 血鬼术散开，我凝结成形。
lines.en: The blood demon art spreads, and I take shape.

lines.zh: 雪地上多出一个小小的人形。
lines.en: A small figure joins the snowfield.

lines.zh: 冰晶落地，长成我的样子。
lines.en: Ice crystals land and grow into me.

lines.zh: 我不是自然生的，是造出来的。
lines.en: I was not born; I was made.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的肩，碎冰四溅。
lines.en: The arrow pierces my shoulder and ice sprays.

lines.zh: 雷劈开我的冰壳，水淌下来。
lines.en: Lightning splits my ice shell, and water runs off.
